quotes: The desired Demon would be a Pit Lord from the Furnace of Pain, due to it being naturally Immune to most damage types other than Physical and Magic. This makes for tanky enough of a pet to survive Uber Tristram and the Colossal Ancients.

You also need to stack as much -xx% Enemy Resistance as possible without tanking the build's Resistances. Hellwarden's Will + Sling and a Sunder Charm with -xx% Enemy Magic Resistance more than doubles your damage output. Make sure to replace a Gheed's Fortune with more damage or survivability, if you're using one.
Prebuffing with Demon Limb and Treachery Breast Plate gives better Attack Rating and Survivability.

Act 5 Frenzy Mercenary with the full Sazabi's Set becomes incredibly tanky, and can survive the attacks of the Ancients with some Potion help. Shift Clicking your Potion number auto feeds them that potion. His main purpose is to apply Open Wounds with Malice Mythical Sword or Crushing Blow with more expensive runeword options. Make sure to prebuff him with Demon Limb and Treachery Breast Plate.
Changelog August 26, 2026: fixed embed for the uber variant mercenary

quotes: The Standard Smiter uses Grief Phase Blade for the Damage +x. It applies to Smite even though it does not show on the tooltip.
Guillaume's Face and Goblin Toe are used for Crushing Blow.
Dracul's Grasp mainly provides Life Tap and +x% Chance of Open Wounds, in addition to extra survivability and stats.
Both Might Aura and Decrepify from The Reaper's Toll increase your Smite damage. Vampire Gaze provides increased +x% Life stolen per hit and Damage Reduction.
At the very least, the Mercenary can hold Treachery until you need to proc Fade on yourself. Note: Be sure to make the Mercenary's Treachery in a non Ethereal base.
One of your biggest threats is Uber Mephisto and his level 20 Conviction Aura. If you have a level 21 or higher Conviction, it cancels out his Aura leaving you unaffected.

quotes: The desired Demon would be a Pit Lord from the Furnace of Pain, due to it being naturally Immune to most damage types other than Physical and Magic. This makes for tanky enough of a pet to survive Uber Tristram and the Colossal Ancients.

You also need to stack as much -xx% Enemy Resistance as possible without tanking the build's Resistances. Hellwarden's Will + Sling and a Sunder Charm with -xx% Enemy Magic Resistance more than doubles your damage output. Make sure to replace a Gheed's Fortune with more damage or survivability, if you're using one.
Prebuffing with Demon Limb and Treachery Breast Plate gives better Attack Rating and Survivability.

Act 5 Frenzy Mercenary with the full Sazabi's Set becomes incredibly tanky, and can survive the attacks of the Ancients with some Potion help. Shift Clicking your Potion number auto feeds them that potion. His main purpose is to apply Open Wounds with Malice Mythical Sword or Crushing Blow with more expensive runeword options. Make sure to prebuff him with Demon Limb and Treachery Breast Plate.

quotes: Duress Dusk Shroud
This budget version of this build is capable of killing Ubers. We recommend a minimum Level of 90 before attempting Ubers, otherwise you'll struggle with your hit chance!
The main focus is to get as many Resistances as possible and use Boots upgraded to the highest base. Cannot Be Frozen and Attack Rating are also extremely important.
Sources of Cannot Be Frozen can be Kira's Guardian, Duriel's Shell, or Ravenfrost. A good source of Attack Rating is the combination of Angelic Halo, and Angelic Wings.
Crushing Blow is extremely important to kill Ubers quickly.

The Fire version of the Iron Wolf provides you with up to +452% Attack Rating by applying Enchant. He will NOT survive the Ubers, so don't worry about keeping him alive. Hexfire Shamshir, Ormus' Robes Dusk Shroud, Flickering Flame, and a Lidless Wall are his optimal setup until he has enough Strength for an Ethereal Spirit Monarch.

An Insight Iron Golem, while not required, provides this build with incredible quality of life.
